summary: Phase E7 RETEST (iteration_26 MEDIUM residual): FlatDrawer Sheet now STAYS OPEN when the Sonner toast Undo button is clicked. The fix in frontend/src/components/ui/sheet.jsx (keepOpenForToasts guard on onPointerDownOutside/onInteractOutside that preventDefaults when target is inside [data-sonner-toaster]) works as specified. The identical guard was also added to frontend/src/components/ui/dialog.jsx. Login as admin@kkt.in → /blocks/4e99bd2c-25eb-45b8-91a5-501b4a5295c2 → click A-801 → FlatDrawer opens → Mark Hold → bottom-right toast with Undo → real page.mouse.click() at (1857,1019) on Undo → status reverts (second toast 'A-801 back to Blocked' fires) AND drawer is STILL VISIBLE. Regression also verified: Esc closes drawer; overlay click (outside at 100,300) closes drawer. All acceptance criteria MET.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/components/ui/sheet.jsx line 46 and dialog.jsx line 26: the keepOpenForToasts helper is correctly wired on BOTH onPointerDownOutside and onInteractOutside; this covers Radix's two outside-interaction paths (pointer and focus). preventDefault is only called when e.target is inside [data-sonner-toaster], so normal overlay/Esc closures are not affected. Clean, surgical fix.

The same shared SheetContent/DialogContent is reused app-wide, so every Radix Sheet/Dialog (FlatDrawer, PostPayment sheet, Reset password dialog, Service resolve dialog, etc.) inherits the fix without further per-component changes.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix verified. The shared SheetContent/DialogContent now preventDefault outside-interaction when the originating target is within [data-sonner-toaster]. Full acceptance met: Undo keeps drawer open; Esc and overlay-click still close modals normally. Screenshots saved as .jpeg at /app/memory/qa/frontend/e7_undo_keepopen_01..04. No open issues from this run.
rca of the issue: iteration_26 showed the toast Undo click was reaching the Sonner action handler but ALSO reaching Radix Dialog's internal onPointerDownOutside, which called onOpenChange(false) and closed the Sheet. The fix wraps the shared SheetContent and DialogContent to run a small guard (keepOpenForToasts) that calls e.preventDefault() when e.target.closest('[data-sonner-toaster]') is truthy, blocking Radix's outside-dismissal only for toast-originated events while leaving overlay/Esc dismissal fully functional.
